state_ref.scope: logical key inside the enclosing selected-profile programme root; the parent stores the complete typed root at this key; not a file path

previous_short.i1_words: exactly five integer values, each 0 or 1, order [L,C,R,Ls,Rs]

canonical_preimage.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted keys lexicographically, compact comma/colon separators, ensure_ascii=false, no BOM, no trailing newline
canonical_preimage.field_rules: Only the two fields above are encoded in this owner value. U64 and I1 values are JSON decimal integers; booleans are rejected.
canonical_preimage.state_sha256: SHA-256 over the complete canonical preimage bytes of the current owner value. Store those full bytes with the typed root; the digest is only an identity check.

owner_state_envelope.generation: must equal codec.generation in the referenced value
owner_state_envelope.state_sha256: digest of complete canonical bytes above
owner_state_envelope.cold_sha256: digest of cold canonical bytes above

proposal_receipt.owner_receipt_fields: Use the existing GTC ownerReceipt exactly: owner_id, before_generation, before_sha256, after_generation, after_sha256, changed, commit_count, transaction_id.
proposal_receipt.staged_codec_value: Complete after owner value/bytes, not digest only. F12 stage has commit_count=0/pending until parent admission.
proposal_receipt.separation: F12 source/provider/frame lineage is not part of canonical persistent codec state bytes; bind it in the existing staged/source receipt and parent transaction.

generation_and_commit.accepted_source: next generation increments once when the parent admits the source codec after-state. previous_short is the block5 current short flag for lanes [L,C,R,Ls,Rs].
generation_and_commit.candidate_failure: Candidate retries do not mutate this owner; all-candidate fatal exposes no normal after codec receipt and committed bytes remain unchanged.
generation_and_commit.suppressed_source0_1: A complete 4096-byte source frame and CRC validation are still required; on accepted source, parent may admit codec after-state without AU append.
generation_and_commit.published_source_ge2: Codec after-state stays pending until the existing F15 durable append/readback/fsync receipt, then parent admits it once with analysis and other owners.
generation_and_commit.reset: Full GTC programme restart reconstructs this codec cold value along with every other owner. No source2 partial reset.

withdrawn_representation: The six 128-word transform histories are Analysis/F08 primary state per the reconciliation amendment; do not duplicate them here. The old 256-word projection, 18 U16 group words and bitwriter cursor are not persistent codec state for this selected clean root.
not_bound_here: source index clock (GTC source lifecycle owner)
F15 output ledger and staging owner
scope: Canonical local GTC codec owner state_ref and receipt mapping only; no native Rev13 ABI or runtime test claim.
